provenance.lateral_accel_max_mps2: advised 2026-09-01: 0.1 g nominal, 0.2 g higher case; raised while comparing lane-change path families, so read as a limit on the maneuver component
provenance.route_normal_accel_max_mps2: placeholder: 9.81*tan(25 deg); normal-operations bank limit for transport aircraft, not an eVTOL figure
provenance.lateral_jerk_max_mps3: EN 13803 line design value 0.5 m/s^3 (0.35 on high-speed lines); an automated-vehicle study reports a 50% lateral-jerk comfort threshold of 0.6 m/s^3
provenance.lateral_speed_limit_mps: unsourced: workspace review lists 8 m/s as an old exploratory component value; held fixed in every case
provenance.min_maneuver_s: unsourced: numerical floor rather than a physical limit; held fixed in every case
provenance.longitudinal_accel_max_mps2: placeholder: simulator default; never exercised in Stage 01 because a_lon = 0
provenance.longitudinal_decel_max_mps2: placeholder: simulator default; never exercised in Stage 01 because a_lon = 0

acceptance: C0 must reproduce R0017 record for record: two lateral moves, fallback time 280 s to 230 s, identical accepted decision times and targets.
C1 must reproduce C0 in completed moves, policy time shares and accepted targets; maneuver durations may differ by at most 0.05 s.

Every limit that governs executed motion is declared once: each case's parameters block carries the same lateral acceleration limit as its envelope, so an independent verifier reading the archive cannot find two contradictory values for one quantity.
Every case reports the maximum route bank angle; exceeding the declared allowance must be flagged.
Every envelope rejection records which condition rejected it.
If C0 or C1 fails, R0022 is void and the number is retired.
The run must pass scripts/verify_spatial_study.py BEFORE it is registered. Registration follows validation, not the run.

The corrected run must reproduce the withdrawn R0022 numbers exactly. The config fix changes only a declaration, not a code path, so any numeric difference indicates a misunderstanding of which limit governs and must stop the run.
notes: Step 01 only: one aircraft, fixed 300 m altitude, lateral actions. No traffic, ACC, separation screening or capacity.
a_lon = 0 throughout, so the longitudinal half of the coupled envelope is never exercised; its first real test needs a scenario with ACC.
Route turning and maneuver acceleration are limited separately: the route term is a steady coordinated turn checked against a bank-angle allowance, the maneuver term is what 0.1 g bounds.
The coupling ellipse is an assumption; the automotive friction circle comes from tyre-road contact and does not establish a shared eVTOL budget.
The envelope check samples the maneuver at a fixed time step and is not a continuous-time proof.
The duration search returns a feasible duration, not a proven minimum; feasibility is not monotone in duration.
Bank angle is a reporting convention derived from acceleration, not a simulated attitude state.
